messages.subject: Clustering Demo Application
parts:
I'd like to share with the group a Clustering Demo Application, which I have deployed on shinyapps.io. 
The application can be found in the URL: https://vaef.shinyapps.io/20_clustering

The application does the following:
  1. Generates aritficial clusters (based on user input: # of desired attributes, # of desired clusters, # of observations, etc) .
  2. Uses a bunch of clustering algorithms (implemened in R) to cluster (segment) the simulated data and then allow the user to compare the resulting clustering with the original simulated parttioning by using plots (of Principal Components, if # of attributes is greater than 2), contingency tables, (internal) clustering evaluation measurments to get a look-and feel of how clustering works.
